mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, u.nick_name AS studentName, s.class_code AS classCode, s.entry_year AS entryYear, s.remark AS remark, u.dept_id AS deptId, d.school_type AS schoolType FROM biz_student s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}
